speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence if you are sitting, and you are sitting. You smell of wet grass and a yard. Which of the two tried to kill you, the comedy or the carpenter?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Neither. An old man loses his wife at the start of a play, and then he waits. Before that, a post at the Theatre took a knife two inches and did not argue. The post is damp. That is the news.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Damp wood is how a house gets a cough. Will they pull it down? I ask because Mistress likes a thing pulled down to be named before supper, not after.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody is pulling the Theatre down. One ground-post is spongy. It was laid in seventy-six. James cursed the man who owns the ground, and Cuthbert asked who pays the carpenter, and nobody said a price. I am not going to invent one at your table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. I do not want a price for another woman's timber in my kitchen. What did you promise, since you came home looking like a man who has promised?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two mornings in March. Lent mornings. I hold what the carpenter tells me to hold. The law stays with James and Cuthbert. Allen is slow to renew. The ground falls back to him on the thirteenth of April in ninety-seven. That is a date, not a vision.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Ninety-seven is not this rent. This rent is Lady Day, and it is not today. Do not bring me a Shoreditch lease and expect me to mourn it between the bread and the salt.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Master Verbeke looked at the table when you said damp. He did not say oak. He nodded the way he nods at weather. I think his loom takes damp, and he was too polite to trade troubles.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we will be as polite as he is. His loom is in Norton Folgate, and it is not a playhouse, and it is not our bill. Alse, do not translate a nod into a story.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No story. He is at the bench. He is not in the timber. I told the Burbages I would come two mornings. I did not tell them I would pay. I told them I would not talk as if a new house were hiding in a rotten one.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And the play? You were an old man. Did the old man find his wife, or is that one of the ones I am not to hear through the floor?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He finds what the play finds, at the end, and I am idle in the middle. I wrote on the part that I am not to hurry the loss of her. You may hear the floor if the floor is loud. You may not have the plot with your supper. Mistress has a ruling already, and I am not collecting a second.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I ruled the forsworn gentlemen. I have not ruled a lost wife, and I do not want her between now and the cheese. Eat. The loaf is still a finger short. The penny is still a penny. Threepence is the meal. You have said your post.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence. A finger short. I am eating. The horn from yesterday is still more full than empty. I did not spend the morning in ink. I spent it in wet grass.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The spoon is paler than it was. Not clean. Paler. I am not putting it back in the ink to finish the job. Mistress has forbidden spoons in that basket, with her eyebrows.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: With my mouth, Alse, which is clearer than eyebrows. The measure is a stick. The spoon is a spoon. Master Shakespeare, if James Burbage wants this house to worry about Giles Allen, he may come and eat the short loaf and worry in person. Until then I have heard the date, and the date is enough.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The date is enough. Two mornings, and no sum. If I come home from those mornings with a price, I will say the price as a thing I was told. I will not smuggle it into a supper ahead of the telling.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And the letter is still upstairs. I dusted round it. I did not open it. Thursday is not tonight, however much a folded paper looks like a task.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thursday. Dust round it as much as you like. The day of coming is still not in it, and the post in Shoreditch is not going into it. Anne is not being asked to mend a beam.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Quite right. Beams are for men who own them, or who lease them, or who curse the man who will have them back. You lease a chamber. You pay threepence when you sit. That is the size of your timber in this house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the size of it. I am done with the north side for today. Tomorrow I am here. If a man calls, he can call. I am not going to the Keys to stand in a play I am not in.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Here is better. The cat is on Ovid again. I moved him once and he returned, with the look of a creature that pays no threepence and owes no apology.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Gib may have the book until morning. You may have the bench until you have finished. Then you may go up. I have had damp, and a date, and a lost wife I did not ask to meet. That is a full supper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A full supper, and a short loaf, and no price. I can live with that inventory. Thank you for not making Allen a guest.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He was never invited. Finish, and take the wet grass upstairs with you. The kitchen has had its date.
